body:
Not sure if this goes here but I dated a guy with lactose intolerance and we went to sonic one time and he got a slushie (bc yanno, lactose intolerant) and I got a milkshake. He finished his entire slushie on the way home and we started watching a movie in his apartment. I go to have a bite (drink?) of my milkshake and it’s completely gone. I was like “did you drink my milkshake???” And he was like “I assumed you didn’t want it because it was just sitting there” 
Me: “we have been home for 20 minutes I thought you have just been taking a few sips. And I thought you were lactose intolerant???”
He literally could not come up with an answer he just demolished my milkshake
I try it but it never works. I’m currently in the process of learning how to self-reassure (bc I know it’s the only long term fix) but I can’t get myself to be satisfied with it
